metadata.title: When Valorant gave me 2 kills for ‘just standing there’ and I’m still confused
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get gifted kills for free?
Enemies probably on a group coffee break.
Click if your aim’s a disaster but the killfeed’s lit.
Valorant logic broke the scoreboard again.

Tap if you ever got kills without even trying!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
